description: Test utility source file defining static methods for QuicStreamPeer class to manipulate and access internal state of QuicStream objects for testing purposes.

classes.name: QuicStreamPeer
classes.description: A class providing static methods to access and modify internal state of QuicStream objects for testing.

methods.name: SetWriteSideClosed
methods.description: Sets the write side closed flag of a QuicStream.

methods.name: SetStreamBytesWritten
methods.description: Sets the number of bytes written in the stream and updates related buffers.

methods.name: SetSendWindowOffset
methods.description: Sets the send window offset for a QuicStream.

methods.name: bytes_consumed
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes consumed by the stream.

methods.name: SetReceiveWindowOffset
methods.description: Sets the receive window offset for a QuicStream.

methods.name: SetMaxReceiveWindow
methods.description: Sets the maximum receive window size for a QuicStream.

methods.name: SendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the current send window size.

methods.name: ReceiveWindowOffset
methods.description: Returns the current receive window offset.

methods.name: ReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the current receive window size.

methods.name: SendWindowOffset
methods.description: Returns the current send window offset.

methods.name: read_side_closed
methods.description: Checks if the read side of the stream is closed.

methods.name: CloseReadSide
methods.description: Closes the read side of the stream.

methods.name: StreamContributesToConnectionFlowControl
methods.description: Checks if the stream contributes to connection flow control.

methods.name: sequencer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the stream's sequencer.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Returns the session associated with the stream.

methods.name: SendBuffer
methods.description: Returns a reference to the stream's send buffer.

methods.name: SetFinReceived
methods.description: Marks the FIN as received on the stream.

methods.name: SetFinSent
methods.description: Marks the FIN as sent on the stream.
